items.title: Add deterministic greeting API
items.goal: Add a public greeting function while preserving normalization behavior.

acceptance.text: greet returns Hello plus normalized non-blank input for varied generated names.
greet rejects blank input with ValueError.

items.title: Add emphatic greeting API
items.goal: Add shout_greeting as a dependent public API without regressing greet or normalize_name.

acceptance.text: shout_greeting returns the normalized greeting in uppercase.
shout_greeting rejects blank input with ValueError.
